lines.en: Hi! I'm Sam.
Hello Sam. I'm Leyla. Nice to meet you.
lines.tr: Merhaba Sam. Ben Leyla. Tanıştığımıza memnun oldum.

lines.en: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
I'm from Turkey. And you?
I'm from Canada. Is this your first time here?
lines.tr: Ben Kanadalıyım. Buraya ilk gelişin mi?

lines.en: Yes, it is. I arrived last week.
Welcome! I hope you like it.
Good morning. What can I get you?
A large coffee, please.
With milk or black?
With milk, please. And a piece of cake.
lines.tr: Sütlü olsun lütfen. Bir de bir dilim pasta.

lines.en: Anything else?
No, thanks. How much is it?
That's eight dollars.
Here you are. Thank you.
Hello. Can I help you?
Yes, where is the milk?
It is next to the eggs.
Thank you. I need bread too.
The bread is over there.
How much is everything?
That is twelve liras.
Is this your family?
Yes, this is my mother.
Do you have any brothers?
I have one brother and one sister.
lines.tr: Bir erkek, bir kız kardeşim var.

lines.en: How old is your sister?
She is ten years old.
Excuse me, what time is it?
It is half past three.
Is the shop still open?
Yes, it closes at six.
Thank you very much.
You are welcome.
Open your books, please.
Which page is it?
Page twenty, at the top.
I do not have my book today.
You can share with your friend.
Okay, thank you teacher.
How is the weather today?
It is cold and windy.
Do you have a coat?
Yes, my coat is very warm.
Will it rain tomorrow?
I think it will be sunny.
Are you ready to order?
Yes, I want a pizza please.
Small or large?
A small one is enough.
Something to drink?
Just water, thank you.
Is this your bag?
No, my bag is blue.
What color is this one?
It is black and very old.
Whose bag is it?
I think it is my brother's.
What is your phone number?
My number is five two one.
And where do you live?
I live near the big park.
Is it far from here?
No, it is very close.
Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic lights.
lines.tr: Dümdüz gidin ve trafik ışıklarından sola dönün.

lines.en: Is it far from here?
About ten minutes on foot.
Can I take a bus instead?
Yes, the number 12 stops right over there.
Thank you so much for your help.
You're welcome. Have a good day!
Hi, can I try this jacket on?
Of course. What size do you need?
Medium, I think. The changing room is over there?
lines.tr: Sanırım orta beden. Deneme kabini şurada mı?

lines.en: Yes, on your right.
It's a bit tight. Do you have a larger one?
lines.tr: Biraz dar. Daha büyüğü var mı?

lines.en: Let me check. Yes, here's a large.
lines.tr: Bir bakayım. Evet, işte büyük beden.

lines.en: This one fits well. I'll take it.
Great. Will you pay by card or in cash?
lines.tr: Harika. Kartla mı nakit mi ödeyeceksiniz?

lines.en: Good evening. Do you have a table for two?
lines.tr: İyi akşamlar. İki kişilik masanız var mı?

lines.en: Yes, please follow me. Here's the menu.
lines.tr: Evet, beni takip edin lütfen. Buyurun menü.

lines.en: Thank you. What do you recommend?
The grilled fish is very popular today.
That sounds good. I'll have the fish, please.
lines.tr: Kulağa güzel geliyor. Balık alayım lütfen.

lines.en: And to drink?
Just water, thanks. Could we get the bill later?
lines.tr: Sadece su, teşekkürler. Hesabı sonra alabilir miyiz?

lines.en: Certainly. Enjoy your meal.
Hello, this is Dr. Kaya's office.
Hi, I'd like to make an appointment.
Sure. When would suit you?
Is Thursday morning possible?
We have an opening at ten o'clock.
That works. My name is Ali Demir.
Thank you. We'll see you on Thursday.
Good afternoon. I have a reservation.
May I have your name, please?
It's under Yilmaz. Two nights.
Found it. Room 305, on the third floor.
Is breakfast included?
Yes, from seven to ten in the morning.
What time do we have to check out?
Before noon. Here is your key card.
Does this bus go to the centre?
Yes, but you need a ticket.
Where can I buy one?
You can buy it from the driver.
How many stops is it?
About six stops, twenty minutes.
Are you free on Saturday?
Yes, I have no plans.
We are having dinner at eight.
That sounds great, I would love to.
Should I pick you up?
No need, I will take a taxi.
You look lost. Can I help?
I am looking for the museum.
It is behind the old church.
Can I walk there from here?
Yes, it takes ten minutes.
Thanks, you saved my day.
What time do you wake up?
I usually get up at seven.
Do you have breakfast at home?
Yes, but I never eat much.
When do you finish work?
I finish around six in the evening.
Good afternoon. How can I help?
I have a bad headache.
How long have you had it?
Since yesterday evening.
Take these twice a day.
Should I take them after meals?
Yes, always after eating.
What seems to be the problem?
I've had a sore throat for three days.
Do you have a fever as well?
A slight one, especially in the evening.
Let me take a look. Open your mouth, please.
Is it serious?
No, it's just an infection. I'll prescribe something.
lines.tr: Hayır, sadece bir enfeksiyon. Bir ilaç yazacağım.

lines.en: How often should I take it?
Twice a day, after meals, for one week.
lines.tr: Günde iki kez, yemeklerden sonra, bir hafta boyunca.

lines.en: Thanks for coming in. Tell me about yourself.
lines.tr: Geldiğiniz için teşekkürler. Bize kendinizden bahsedin.

lines.en: I've worked as a designer for four years.
Why do you want to leave your current job?
lines.tr: Şu anki işinizden neden ayrılmak istiyorsunuz?

lines.en: I'm looking for more responsibility.
What would you say is your biggest weakness?
I sometimes take on too much at once.
lines.tr: Bazen aynı anda çok fazla iş üstleniyorum.

lines.en: Do you have any questions for us?
lines.tr: Bize sormak istediğiniz bir şey var mı?

lines.en: Yes, what does a typical week look like?
lines.tr: Evet, tipik bir hafta nasıl geçiyor?

lines.en: Terrible weather today, isn't it?
Awful. It hasn't stopped raining since Monday.
They say it'll clear up by the weekend.
I hope so. I've got plans on Saturday.
Anything nice?
We're going hiking, if the weather allows.
Sounds great. Fingers crossed for you.
lines.tr: Kulağa harika geliyor. Şansın açık olsun.

lines.en: Do you have an appointment?
No, but I need to see a doctor urgently.
lines.tr: Hayır ama acilen bir doktora görünmem gerekiyor.

lines.en: What exactly is the problem?
I have been feeling dizzy for two days.
Have you taken any medication?
Only painkillers, but they did not help.
lines.tr: Sadece ağrı kesici ama işe yaramadı.

lines.en: Please wait, the doctor will call you.
How may I assist you today?
I would like to open a savings account.
Do you have your identity card with you?
Yes, here it is.
Is there a monthly fee for this account?
lines.tr: Bu hesabın aylık ücreti var mı?

lines.en: Could you explain the fees in detail?
Of course, there is no monthly charge.
This is the living room.
It is brighter than I expected.
The rent is nine thousand a month.
Are the bills included in that price?
No, you pay water and electricity.
lines.tr: Hayır, su ve elektriği siz ödüyorsunuz.

lines.en: Would you consider a lower price?
lines.tr: Daha düşük bir fiyatı değerlendirir misiniz?

lines.en: I can discuss it with the owner.
Which flight were you on?
I arrived from Berlin an hour ago.
Can you describe your suitcase?
It is a large grey one with wheels.
Was there anything valuable inside?
lines.tr: İçinde değerli bir şey var mıydı?

lines.en: Mostly clothes and some documents.
We will contact you as soon as possible.
lines.tr: En kısa sürede sizinle iletişime geçeceğiz.

lines.en: Technical support, how can I help?
My internet keeps disconnecting.
When did the problem start?
It started right after the storm.
Have you restarted the router?
I tried that several times already.
Then we will send a technician.
What do you do in your free time?
I have been learning the guitar recently.
How often do you practise?
Almost every evening for an hour.
Is it difficult to learn?
The beginning was harder than I thought.
You should keep going then.
Good evening. Is everything all right?
lines.tr: İyi akşamlar. Her şey yolunda mı?

lines.en: Actually, the heating in my room is not working.
I am very sorry to hear that.
I reported it this morning as well.
Let me check what happened.
I would rather change rooms if possible.
Of course, I will arrange that immediately.
I'd like to return this. It stopped working after two days.
lines.tr: Bunu iade etmek istiyorum. İki gün sonra çalışmayı bıraktı.

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
lines.tr: Bunu duyduğuma üzüldüm. Fişiniz var mı?

lines.en: Here it is. I bought it last Friday.
Would you prefer a refund or a replacement?
lines.tr: Para iadesi mi yoksa değişim mi tercih edersiniz?

lines.en: A refund, please. I'd rather not risk it again.
lines.tr: Para iadesi lütfen. Aynı riski tekrar almak istemem.

lines.en: That's fair enough. It may take a few days to process.
lines.tr: Bu makul. İşlemin birkaç gün sürmesi mümkün.

lines.en: That's fine, as long as it goes back to my card.
lines.tr: Kartıma geri döndüğü sürece sorun değil.

lines.en: I think we should postpone the launch.
I see your point, but we've already announced the date.
lines.tr: Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama tarihi çoktan duyurduk.

lines.en: True, though shipping a broken product would cost us more.
lines.tr: Doğru, ama bozuk bir ürün çıkarmak bize daha pahalıya patlar.

lines.en: Fair point. What do you suggest?
We could release it to a small group first.
That sounds like a reasonable compromise.
lines.tr: Bu makul bir orta yol gibi görünüyor.

lines.en: Let's put it to the team and decide by Friday.
lines.tr: Ekibe soralım ve cumaya kadar karar verelim.

lines.en: These costs seem far too high.
They reflect the extra staff we hired.
Could we reduce them next quarter?
Only if we slow down the project.
That is not an option right now.
lines.tr: Bu şu an bir seçenek değil.

lines.en: Then the budget has to stay as it is.
lines.tr: O halde bütçe olduğu gibi kalmalı.

lines.en: Our final offer is quite firm.
I appreciate that, but it is below our limit.
lines.tr: Anlıyorum ama bu bizim sınırımızın altında.

lines.en: What figure did you have in mind?
We were hoping for ten percent more.
That would be difficult to justify.
Perhaps we could meet in the middle.
Let me take that back to my team.
Was the move difficult for you?
lines.tr: Taşınmak senin için zor oldu mu?

lines.en: The language was easier than the customs.
What surprised you the most?
How early people have dinner here.
lines.tr: Buradakilerin akşam yemeğini ne kadar erken yemesi.

lines.en: Do you miss anything from home?
lines.tr: Memleketinden özlediğin bir şey var mı?

lines.en: Mostly the way neighbours visit each other.
When did the accident take place?
Last Tuesday, shortly after midday.
Was anyone injured?
Fortunately nobody was hurt at all.
Do you have a police report?
Yes, I submitted it online yesterday.
Then your claim will be processed shortly.
lines.tr: O halde talebiniz kısa sürede işleme alınacak.

lines.en: Did you read about the new law?
I did, though the coverage seemed biased.
In what way exactly?
They only quoted people who supported it.
That is a fair criticism.
A second source would have helped.
Where do you see yourself in five years?
lines.tr: Kendini beş yıl sonra nerede görüyorsun?

lines.en: Leading a small team of my own.
What skills are you missing for that?
Mainly experience in managing conflict.
How do you plan to gain it?
By taking on more responsibility gradually.
lines.tr: Kademeli olarak daha fazla sorumluluk alarak.

lines.en: The area is developing very quickly.
That is exactly what worries me.
Why would growth be a concern?
Prices may fall once the boom ends.
Historically that has not happened here.
Past performance guarantees nothing.
lines.tr: Geçmiş performans hiçbir şeyi garanti etmez.

lines.en: Your figures were impressive.
Thank you, they took months to gather.
How reliable is the sample size?
It covers roughly a third of our users.
Would a larger sample change the result?
lines.tr: Daha büyük bir örneklem sonucu değiştirir miydi?

lines.en: The trend would almost certainly remain.
Your conclusion rests on a narrow dataset.
lines.tr: Sonucunuz dar bir veri kümesine dayanıyor.

lines.en: Narrow, perhaps, but deliberately selected.
lines.tr: Dar olabilir ama bilinçli olarak seçilmiş.

lines.en: On what grounds did you exclude the rest?
The excluded cases lacked comparable measurements.
That risks confirming what you expected.
I addressed that with a blind review stage.
lines.tr: Bunu kör inceleme aşamasıyla ele aldım.

lines.en: This clause exposes you to liability.
lines.tr: Bu madde sizi sorumluluğa açık bırakıyor.

lines.en: Could we limit it to gross negligence?
The other party is unlikely to accept.
lines.tr: Karşı tarafın kabul etmesi olası değil.

lines.en: Then a cap on damages might work.
lines.tr: O halde tazminat üst sınırı işe yarayabilir.

lines.en: That is a more realistic position.
Draft it and I will review the wording.
Industry always claims the cost is unbearable.
lines.tr: Sanayi her zaman maliyetin katlanılmaz olduğunu iddia eder.

lines.en: Some of those claims are not unfounded.
Are you defending the polluters?
I am arguing for a realistic timetable.
lines.tr: Gerçekçi bir takvim için argüman sunuyorum.

lines.en: Delay has consequences of its own.
So does a policy nobody can follow.
lines.tr: Kimsenin uyamayacağı bir politikanın da öyle.

lines.en: Users consented to the terms.
Consent buried in forty pages is questionable.
That is the industry standard, though.
A common practice is not automatically ethical.
lines.tr: Yaygın bir uygulama kendiliğinden etik olmaz.

lines.en: What would you propose instead?
Plain summaries and genuinely revocable permissions.
lines.tr: Sade özetler ve gerçekten geri alınabilir izinler.

lines.en: The press will publish within hours.
Then we should speak before they do.
Admitting fault could invite lawsuits.
lines.tr: Hata kabul etmek davaları davet edebilir.

lines.en: Concealing it would cost us far more.
lines.tr: Gizlemek bize çok daha pahalıya patlar.

lines.en: Legal will resist that approach.
Then let them shape the wording, not the decision.
lines.tr: O halde kararı değil, ifadeyi onlar şekillendirsin.

lines.en: The projected return looks remarkable.
Remarkable returns usually carry hidden risk.
lines.tr: Dikkat çekici getiriler genelde gizli risk taşır.

lines.en: Our model accounts for volatility.
Models rarely anticipate structural shocks.
So you would advise against it?
I would advise a considerably smaller position.
lines.tr: Belirgin biçimde daha küçük bir pozisyon tavsiye ederim.

lines.en: The documentary was widely praised.
Praise and accuracy are not the same thing.
lines.tr: Övgü ve doğruluk aynı şey değil.

lines.en: You found it misleading?
It omitted every inconvenient counterexample.
lines.tr: Rahatsız edici her karşı örneği atladı.

lines.en: Perhaps for the sake of a clear narrative.
Clarity bought with omission is propaganda.
Do you believe people genuinely change?
Circumstances change; character bends slowly.
That sounds rather pessimistic.
I would call it patient rather than pessimistic.
lines.tr: Ben buna karamsar değil, sabırlı derim.

lines.en: What would convince you otherwise?
Consistent behaviour over many difficult years.
The reform passed with a comfortable majority.
A majority does not guarantee a good law.
lines.tr: Çoğunluk iyi bir yasayı garanti etmez.

lines.en: Should the minority simply be ignored?
lines.tr: Azınlık öylece göz ardı mı edilmeli?

lines.en: On the contrary, that is precisely my point.
lines.tr: Aksine, demek istediğim tam olarak bu.

lines.en: Then how would you proceed?
With a longer consultation and clearer safeguards.
lines.tr: Daha uzun bir istişare ve daha net güvencelerle.

lines.en: Critics say your findings were rushed.
The timeline was short but the method was not compromised.
lines.tr: Takvim kısaydı ama yöntemden ödün verilmedi.

lines.en: Can you demonstrate that?
Every step is documented and independently reproducible.
lines.tr: Her adım belgelenmiş ve bağımsız olarak yinelenebilir.

lines.en: Has anyone reproduced it yet?
Two laboratories are working on it now.
lines.tr: Şu anda iki laboratuvar üzerinde çalışıyor.

lines.en: He said the proposal was interesting.
Coming from him, that is faint praise indeed.
lines.tr: Ondan gelince bu, ancak yarım ağız bir övgü olur.

lines.en: You read a great deal into one word.
lines.tr: Tek bir kelimeden çok şey çıkarıyorsunuz.

lines.en: With him the omissions carry the meaning.
So he intends to reject it?
He intends to let it quietly expire.
Our position on this remains unchanged.
Then perhaps we should reframe the question entirely.
lines.tr: O halde belki soruyu tümüyle yeniden çerçevelemeliyiz.

lines.en: Reframing rarely resolves substance.
It can, however, reveal where the substance actually lies.
lines.tr: Yine de esasın gerçekte nerede olduğunu açığa çıkarabilir.

lines.en: That is an elegant way of stalling.
I would rather stall than sign something unworkable.
lines.tr: Uygulanamaz bir şeyi imzalamaktansa oyalanmayı yeğlerim.

lines.en: The ending struck me as unearned.
lines.tr: Son bana hak edilmemiş gibi geldi.

lines.en: Unearned, or deliberately withheld?
lines.tr: Hak edilmemiş mi, yoksa bilinçli olarak esirgenmiş mi?

lines.en: Is there a meaningful difference?
One is a failure of craft, the other a choice.
lines.tr: Biri zanaat kusuru, diğeri bir tercih.

lines.en: And which do you take it to be?
A choice, given how carefully everything else is built.
lines.tr: Bir tercih, geri kalanın ne kadar özenle kurulduğuna bakılırsa.

lines.en: The correlation is undeniably strong.
Strength of correlation says nothing about direction.
lines.tr: Korelasyonun gücü yön hakkında hiçbir şey söylemez.

lines.en: We controlled for the obvious confounders.
The obvious ones are seldom the dangerous ones.
What would satisfy you?
A prospective study with a preregistered hypothesis.
lines.tr: Önceden kaydedilmiş hipotezle ileriye dönük bir çalışma.

lines.en: They dropped the project overnight.
I saw that coming a mile off.
Nobody else seemed to.
They were clutching at straws from the start.
lines.tr: Başından beri çaresizce tutunacak dal arıyorlardı.

lines.en: Will they try again next year?
Once bitten, twice shy, I would imagine.
lines.tr: Sanırım sütten ağzı yanan yoğurdu üfleyerek yer.

lines.en: He described the plan as ambitious.
Ambitious is what one calls a plan one expects to fail.
lines.tr: Hırslı, başarısız olmasını beklediğin plana verilen addır.

lines.en: That is unusually blunt of you.
lines.tr: Bu senden alışılmadık derecede açık sözlü.

lines.en: Only because tact has already been tried.
lines.tr: Yalnızca nezaket daha önce denendiği için.

lines.en: And what came of it?
Six months and a very expensive silence.
lines.tr: Altı ay ve çok pahalı bir sessizlik.

lines.en: You knowingly withheld the information.
I withheld it until it could be verified.
Others might call that convenient timing.
lines.tr: Başkaları buna işine gelen zamanlama diyebilir.

lines.en: Premature disclosure would have harmed innocent people.
lines.tr: Erken açıklama masum insanlara zarar verirdi.

lines.en: Who granted you that judgement?
Nobody. That is precisely what made it difficult.
lines.tr: Kimse. Zor olan tam olarak buydu.

lines.en: The board will not accept another delay.
lines.tr: Yönetim kurulu bir gecikmeyi daha kabul etmez.

lines.en: Then let us not present it as a delay.
lines.tr: O halde bunu gecikme olarak sunmayalım.

lines.en: You want to disguise the truth?
I want to describe it in terms they can act on.
lines.tr: Onu, harekete geçebilecekleri terimlerle anlatmak istiyorum.

lines.en: That is a fine line to walk.
lines.tr: Bu, ince bir çizgide yürümek demek.

lines.en: Every honest persuasion walks it.
lines.tr: Her dürüst ikna o çizgide yürür.

lines.en: Your framework borrows heavily from earlier work.
lines.tr: Çerçeveniz önceki çalışmalardan fazlasıyla ödünç alıyor.

lines.en: It builds on it, and says so explicitly.
lines.tr: Onun üzerine inşa ediyor ve bunu açıkça belirtiyor.

lines.en: Where then is the original contribution?
In applying it to a domain nobody had tested.
Some would consider that incremental.
Most durable knowledge is built incrementally.
lines.tr: En kalıcı bilgi kademeli olarak kurulur.

lines.en: I felt you dismissed me in front of everyone.
That was never my intention, and I regret how it landed.
lines.tr: Bu asla niyetim değildi ve nasıl algılandığına üzülüyorum.

lines.en: Intention does not undo the effect.
You are right, and I should have corrected it immediately.
What will be different next time?
I will raise disagreements privately, not in the room.
lines.tr: İtirazlarımı odada değil, özel olarak dile getireceğim.
